Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Litton Das and Anamul Haque will open the batting for Bangladesh! Akeal Hosein will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! West Indies have put up a good total on the board. But this wicket is assisting the batters and Bangladesh will be hoping they can chase this one down. Also, there is good news! The covers are coming off and we should start on time. Stay tuned for the second essay!

Brandon King says that they started well and then Rovman Powell finished off things really well. Adds that the talk with the skipper was just to keep it ticking along and they batted well together. Mentions that the surface is very good and the ball is coming onto the bat pretty good. Adds that the bowlers will have to use the variations and reckons they can defend the total.

Nicholas Pooran would be happy after winning the toss! His team has certainly justified his decision to bat first. Brandon King and Rovman Powell were the main architects of setting a target of 194 runs! Brandon King and Nicholas Pooran helped their side recover well after the early hiccups, and Rovman Powell finished the innings off in style. He scored 61 runs off 28 balls and guided West Indies to a huge total. They would feel they have enough runs on the board and seeing their bowling show in the precious game, they could fancy their chances of winning the game.

Bangladesh began proceedings by leaking runs in their first over but they fought back well by picking up wickets in quick succession and put West Indies on the back foot slightly. Post that, the momentum shifted towards the home side. Pooran and King started scoring runs freely and took control of the innings. They did manage to grab the wickets of Nicholas Pooran and Brandon King but had no answers to the hard-hitting skills displayed by Rovman Powell. Once he was at the crease, all their bowlers were taken to the cleaners! Bangladesh do face a tough task, but they have enough quality to chase this one down. Onto the batters now!

An innings filled with entertainment! The fans at Dominica were disappointed after not being able to witness a full game in the first T20I, but they have been treated with some exuberant power-hitting skills in this game. Powell has powered West Indies to a healthy total here! Also, there is a slight drizzle as the players walk off for the interval. For the moment, the groundstaff are out with the covers.

SIX! BOOM! What a way to end the innings! Shoriful Islam misses his mark and delivers it in the slot. Rovman Powell clears the front leg and just smashes the ball way, way over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit. West Indies finish at 193/5!
Gets the perfect yorker in this time, Smith can only manage to dig it out towards long on for one.
Mistimed but safe! Full, around off, Smith slices this one over wide mid off and races back for the second.

SIX! Odean Smith and his muscular shoulders have done the trick here. This is banged in short and on leg stump, Smith just takes it on and nails the pull shot over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
Slower one, around leg stump. Odean Smith works it off the back foot and behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Odean Smith is the new man in!

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man! Shoriful Islam and his strong display of death bowling continues. Bowls it from over the wicket, full and wide, across the right-hander. Romario Shepherd looks to slash it over point but hits it straight to the man over there. Mahedi Hasan takes a sharp catch around his face and Shepherd has to depart. Shoriful gets his second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahedi Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Full and straight, drilled down to long on for a single.
Penalty! Bangladesh are one over behind as per the over rate and they will only be allowed to place 4 fielders outside the inner circle.

No ball! Cardinal sin this from Mustafizur Rahman and it has been a pretty wayward over from him. Nails the yorker on the pads, Powell flicks it towards mid-wicket for one. The Fizz though has overstepped and a Free-Hit will now follow.

Another valiant effort from Litton Das but Romario Shepherd survives. This is pitched up on middle stump, Shepherd clears the front leg to go downtown but mistimes it badly. The ball is lofted towards mid on and Das comes racing in from long on. Das dives forward but only manages to get a fingertip on the ball. Just a single is taken.
Gets it full again but around off this time, Powell can only manage to bunt it towards mid off for a single.
WIDE! Continues his search for the yorker at the pads but once again spills it down the leg side.

Just a bit of yes and no out there in the middle but no harm is done. Full and on the pads, this is flicked away towards deep mid-wicket. Powell wants two and they do go for it in the end. The fielding in the deep is a bit sloppy and the batters make it home safely.
Excellent delivery! Banged in short and on leg stump, this is at a good height, just over the batter's shoulders. Powell decides not to take it on and lets it through.
WIDE! Mustafizur Rahman tries to bowl it full and at the pads but drifts down the leg side yet agin. Wide called.
WIDE! This is a bit shorter and way down the leg side, wided.

No wide given! Rovman Powell stands outside the leg stump and Mustafizur Rahman tries to bowl full and at the pads. Powell leaves the ball alone but it might have flicked the pad on its way to the keeper.
Fuller and on the pads, slower too. Powell nudges it leg side for a run.
Excellent over so far from Shoriful Islam! Slower bumper this time, over middle and leg. Rovman Powell tries to take it on but is undone by the lack of pace.
Full and wide again, played towards cover for a quick single.

No review taken! Full and well wide, slanted across the batter. Romario Shepherd tries to reach it but can't. Nurul Hasan collects the ball and goes up with the bowler too being interested. Mahmudullah opts not to review it and the replay confirms that he is correct as the bat hit the ground and not the ball.
FIFTY for Rovman Powell and what a blistering innings this has been so far! Full and around off, driven towards long off for a single. Powell will now look to finish off the innings in style.
Romario Shepherd walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Brandon King holes out but he has done his job! Shoriful Islam comes back into the attack and starts off with a length ball around off. The pace is taken off the ball and King tries to take it on. King can only manage to sky it towards the wide long off fence though. Shakib Al Hasan runs around to his left from long off and takes a safe catch. A bit of respite for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Shakib Al Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Shoriful Islam is back on!
FOUR! A bit of sub-continental flair in that shot! Full and straight, Powell whips it off his legs and drills it into the wide long on fence.
Nails the yorker this time does Taskin. Powell does well to get some bat on it and the ball gets squeezed past the leg stump and goes towards fine leg. The batters race back for two.

NOT OUT! Taskin Ahmed looks for the yorker again but serves a full toss this time, angling into middle stump. Brandon King comes down the track and looks to whip it away but misses and gets pinged on the pads. The ball rolls towards cover-point as the batters pick up asingle. Huge appeal for lbw but it is not given! The Bangladeshi players seem confident and Mahmudullah has gone upstairs. The UltraEdge is checked first and there is a huge inside edge. The original decision stands.
Pace off the ball this time, around off. Powell dabs it down towards short third man and rotates the strike.
WIDE! Goes for the wide yorker but misses the mark by a long way, wide called.

SIX! BACK-TO-BACK! Tasking bangs it in short but without any real intent, Rovman Powell walks towards the ball and just clobbers it away over the square leg fence for yet another biggie. Powell's flying at the moment.

SIX! OUTTA HERE! Poor delivery from Taskin Ahmed, serves it in the slot on middle stump. Powell just swings through the line and launches it deep on the grass banks over the long on fence. West Indies eyeing 200 now.
Taskin Ahmed (2-0-25-0) comes back to bowl!

A dot to end an expensive final over from Shakib Al Hasan, 23 runs come off it! Brandon King backs away pretty early, exposing the stumps. Shakib bowls it flatter and on middle, King miscues the cut shot towards backward point.
Fired in a bit quicker, on middle. Powell drives it past mid on for a single.

SIX! My word, this is serious ball striking from Rovman Powell! Shakib Al Hasan comes from around the wicket and pushes it wider, Powell goes deep in his crease and lifts it inside-out over the long off fence for a third maximum in this over.
SIX! Slogged away! Flighted this time from Shakib, but on a shorter length. Powell latches onto it and flat-bats it over the square leg fence. Windies in the ascendancy at the moment.
FOUR! Rovman Powell is turning on the heat here. On middle, Powell advances and hammers it past wide long on for a boundary. 10 off the first two deliveries.
SIX! MUSCLED! Shakib floats it up on middle and leg, Rovman Powell clears the front leg and clears the man at the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Another low full toss, on the pads this time. Rovman Powell flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Brandon King backs away and knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Top shot this from King! A short one, around middle and off. Brandon King smashes this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

A mix-up...but no harm done! Another length delivery, outside off. Rovman Powell dabs it towards backward point. After a bit of yes and no, the batters cross ends for a single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses.
Leg bye! On a length, around middle and leg. Brandon King looks to pull this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pads. The ball rolls towards point and the batters sneak in a leg bye.

Pitched up, outside off. Rovman Powell lunges forward and drives it towards deep cover. The fielder there runs to his right, dives and keeps the ball away from the ropes. Saved a run there! Three taken!
Mustafizur Rahman is brought back into the attack.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Rovman Powell drives it down to long on and retains the strike with a single.
Quicker, on middle, fuller one. Brandon King gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Brandon King brings up his fifty in style! Flatter ball, around off, fullish. Brandon King makes room and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary. A lovely knock from King so far!
Fuller one, around middle. Rovman Powell miscues his sweep shot over the keeper. Only a single.
Another short one, around middle. Rovman Powell flicks this one but this is not in the gap. No run there!
Shorter, spinning away a tad, around middle. Brandon King flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Quicker, tighter line this time, around off. Rovman Powell stays in his crease and blocks it out. A wicket maiden from Mosaddek Hossain!
Pulls his length back a tad, around middle again. Rovman Powell blocks it towards the leg side.
Full, around middle. Rovman Powell tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Rovman Powell is the new man at the crease.

OUT! Mosaddek Hossain gets the much-needed breakthrough for Bangladesh! He sends the West Indies skipper back to the hut! A fuller one, attacking the stumps. Nicholas Pooran gets down on his knee and tries to reverse-hit this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. Huge appeal for LBW...it is given! Nicholas Pooran however reviews it right away. It did seem pretty close at first glance and UltraEdge shows that there's no bat involved. Ball Tracking then comes up with three reds and Pooran has to depart.
Flatter, quicker, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pushes it back to the bowler.

Stumping chance! A fuller ball, down the leg side. Nicholas Pooran tries to reverse-sweep this but he misses. Nurul Hasan collects the ball and removes the bails off. A tad late in doing so. The umpires take it upstairs to check if that is out. The replays show that Nicholas Pooran's bat is grounded just in time. He survives!
An appeal for a stumping from Nurul Hasan and it is sent upstairs. The third umpire is called in and the replays show that Nicholas Pooran managed to get his bat down in time. NOT OUT!
Mosaddek Hossain to roll his arm now.
Single to end the over! Short again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single. He retains the strike! 100 up for West Indies!
Back of a length, around off. Brandon King pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Another shorter ball, around middle. Nicholas Pooran lifts it towards long on. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Single taken!
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander, serves another shorter one, around middle, quick as well. Brandon King uses the depth of his crease and miscues his pull to deep mid-wicket for a single.
NO BALL! Short again, around off. Nicholas Pooran knocks it long off for a single. Shakib Al Hasan has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free Hit coming up!
Fuller this time, around middle, quicker. Nicholas Pooran looks to sweeps this away but he misses and gets hit on this thigh pads.
Back of a length, around off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out.
Shakib Al Hasan (1-0-1-1) is back on.
Shorter one this time, around middle. Nicholas Pooran miscues his pull shot towards long on for a single.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper is not happy with his willow and out comes the 12th man with a new one. Also, there is a bit of a drizzle here and there but for the moment the ground staff isn't concerned.
On a length, outside off, slower in pace. Brandon King advances down the track and cuts it towards deep point. Single taken!
Well bowled! Shoriful Islam watches Brandon King step down the track and he serves a shorter ball, around middle, cramps him for room there. Brandon King fends it away towards point.
Shoriful Islam pitches it up this time, around middle and off. Nicholas Pooran tries to drive this but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid on. A single taken!
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, outside off, at 131 clicks. Nicholas Pooran tries to pull this but he fails to get any bat on it.
Wide! This time a length ball, wide of off. Nicholas Pooran lets that go through to the keeper. Wide given!
Wide! Too short on this occasion, around middle and off. Nicholas Pooran dances down the track and leaves it alone. Wide called for height!
FOUR! Pulled away! Back of a length, around middle and off. Nicholas Pooran swivels and pulls this in the gap between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for a boundary.
Good running! Fired in at the pads, Pooran works it 'round the corner for a quick single. At the halfway mark, West Indies are 85/2!
Switches to around the wicket and slants it across the off stump, this is cut away hard and towards deep point for a run.

SIX! Swings across the line and gets maximum purchase! Flighted, on a length and turning it in from outside off. Brandon King gets down on one knee and flat-bats it between deep mid-wicket and long on for a biggie. West Indies motoring along at the moment.
Sliding onto the pads, this is wristed towards mid-wicket for one more.
Very full again, outside off and over 100 clicks. King plays it towards backward point this time and picks up a single.
Fired in around off stump at 103 KPH, King jams it out on the off side.
Full and on leg stump, driven down the ground towards long on for one.
Good short ball! This is around leg stump and hurrying onto the batter, King just ducks under it.
FOUR! Poor delivery from the Fizz and it is duly punished! A half-volley, outside off, King stands tall and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.

Almost an unreal catch from Litton Das! This is pitched up right in the slot but it is slower again. Brandon King launches it off the toe end of the bat towards the wide long on fence. Das runs around from long on and stretches to his right to grab the catch but just as his momentum seems to be taking him over the ropes, Das manages to throw the ball back into play. Two runs are taken.
Length ball, angling into middle and leg, Pooran works it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Slight misfield and that allows the single. Full and straight, all the pace is taken off the ball though, King nudges it towards backward point where Mahedi Hasan slips and fumbles.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back into the attack. He went for 8 runs in his first over.
Around middle, this is defended off the front foot by Pooran.

Excellent work from Taskin Ahmed, saves a run for his side. On the pads, Brandon King tickles it fine and the ball seems to be heading towards the ropes, Taskin though runs around to his right and manages to pull it back in time. Three runs taken.
Smart from Mahedi Hasan, sees Pooran advancing and pushes it full and wide. Pooran manages to reach it and squeeze it behind point for one.
Floated up this time, around off, Pooran strokes it towards covers.
FOUR! Full range from Nicholas Pooran! This is angled into middle and leg, Pooran gets down on one knee and plays the reverse sweep beautifully over backward point for a boundary.
On a length, on middle and turning in. Brandon King hops back and pushes it through mid on for a single.
Another slower delivery, this is pushed wider. King waits for it and then reaches out to cut it towards deep point for one. 11 runs off it, a good over for the Windies.
Goes full, at 138 clicks and on off stump. This is right in the block hole and King does well to jam it out on the off side.
Change of pace now. This is slower from Taskin, on off stump, Pooran opens the face of the bat and just steers it past backward point for a run.
Well-controlled! Banged in short and over middle, Pooran gets on top of the bounce and pulls it well in front of mid-wicket to pick up a brace.
SIX! Up and away! A regulation length ball, angled into middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran hangs deep and just picks it up before dispatching it way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Shorter in length and outside off, King slaps it away but straight to the man at the cover fence. Just a single then.
Taskin Ahmed is back on! He went for 14 runs in his first over.
Down the leg side, Pooran nudges it fine, past the man at short fine leg and picks up a couple of runs. At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies are 46/2!
Flatter delivery, angling in on middle, Pooran keeps it out.
FOUR! Hits it well enough! Around middle and leg, Pooran advances and lofts it over the man at mid on for a boundary.

Hasan tries to attack the pads but drifts down the leg side. Nicholas Pooran misses the flick and the keeper whips off the bails. There is a stifled appeal for stumping. Wide signaled but the umpires have gone upstairs for a stumping chance. The replay shows that the back leg is rooted inside the crease.
Quicker and flatter, on off stump. Nicholas Pooran camps back and pushes it out on the off side.
Switches to around the wicket for the left-hander and angles it in from around off. Pooran keeps it out.
Fires it in on middle stump, Brandon King uses his feet to push it down to long on for a run.
Outside off, on a length. Nicholas Pooran opens the face of the bat and taps it towards backward point.
There is a drizzle in the air! The sun is beaming bright but the rain is there to accompany it as well, probably just a passing shower.
Shoriful Islam drops it short, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pulls it towards sqaure leg. Two taken!
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Brandon King clips it past square leg for a single.

FOUR! Edgy one this time! Good-length delivery, width on offer. Brandon King hangs back and tries to slash this one but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the keeper and towards third man for a boundary. Streaky runs!
FOUR! Exquisite shot! A touch fuller, around off. Brandon King leans forward and drives it powerfully past mid off for a boundary.
Shoriful Islam begins with a length ball, outside off, a touch slower. Brandon King stays in his crease and tries to cut this but he misses.
Mahmudullah ringing in the changes here as Shoriful Islam is inserted into the attack.
Flatter, quicker, and much straighter, around off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out solidly. End of a successful over from Shakib Al Hasan!
Firing it on the pads, pushes it up this time. Brandon King flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Back of a length, this one comes in with the arm, around middle. Brandon King pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Tad shorter, around middle. Brandon King blocks it out off the back foot.
The skipper, Nicholas Pooran is in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Shakib Al Hasan comes into the attack and strikes straightaway! Good change of bowling from Mahmudullah. This time Shakib Al Hasan tosses it up, full, around off. Shamarh Brooks tries to heave this over mid-wicket. But the ball goes off the top edge towards mid on. Mahmudullah keeps his eyes on the ball and grabs it safely. West Indies in trouble early on!
Commentary.Howout: c Mahmudullah b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle, quicker. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl now.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Brandon King! A tad fuller on this occasion, outside off. Brandon King presses forward and drives it past the diving fielder at mid off for another boundary. 8 runs off Mustafizur Rahman's first over!
FOUR! Lovely shot! A length delivery, outside off. Brandon King drives this on the up past mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length this time, around middle and leg, Brandon King looks to pull this but he misses and gets hit high on his thigh pad.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Brandon King dabs it towards backward point.
Beaten this time! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Brandon King stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses.
Mustafizur Rahman begins with a fuller ball, around middle. Brandon King pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack now.
Full, darting it on the pads. Shamarh Brooks tucks it towards square leg. Good come back from Mahedi Hasan!
Shamarh Brooks is in at number 3.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Yes, he does go for the big one but he holes out! Mahedi Hasan draws first blood. He gets rid of the dangerous, Kyle Mayers! This one comes in with the angle, fuller, around middle. Kyle Mayers gets down on his knee and tries to smash this over mid-wicket but he misses. The ball goes on to shutter the stumps.
Flatter, shorter, outside off. Kyle Mayers cuts this one and finds the fielder at point. Three dots in a row! Will he go for a big shot now?
Shorter one again, around middle. Kyle Mayers pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter this time, spinning away, outside off. Kyle Mayers pushes it off the back foot towards cover.

FOUR! Kyle Mayers greets Mahedi Hasan with a boundary! That was straight as an arrow! A loopy ball, full, around middle. Kyle Mayers stays in his crease and tonks it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl from the opposite end.
Change of angle now! Taskin Ahmed comes 'round the wicket, serves a length ball, wide of off. Kyle Mayers guides it down to third man for a single. He retains the strike! 14 runs off the first over!
SIX! BANG! Kyle Mayers has come out to bat with some intent! Pitched up once again, outside off as well. Kyle Mayers gets low and smokes it high over mid off for a biggie.
Kyle Mayers takes the aerial route once again! Another fuller ball, outside off again. Kyle Mayers slices it over backward point. Two taken!
FOUR! First ball for Kyle Mayers and he puts it away! He gets off the mark in style! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Kyle Mayers drives it uppishly over cover for a boundary.
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg, at 139 clicks. Brandon King tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. West Indies and Brandon King are up and running!
Taskin Ahmed begins with a fuller ball, around off. Brandon King drives firmly and finds the fielder at short cover.

We are ready for play! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Bangladesh players spread out on the field as the Windies openers, Brandon King and Kyle Mayers take guard. Taskin Ahmed has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Before the first ball, all players take the knee to show their continued support for the BLM movement. Let's play...

Hayden Walsh says that his performance in the first T20I went well, he was just trying to execute his plan. Adds that his plan for the left-handers was to move the ball away and keep it away from their hitting area. Mentions that he has played in India before, and he is kind of used to bowling with a wet ball. Concludes by saying that he loved the crowd at Dominica, he feels it makes the atmosphere more electric.

Pitch Report - Daren Ganga is pitchside. He mentions that the good news is that the sun is out today. Mentions that the pitch is hard and there will be extra bounce and the key for the bowlers will be going pace on and pace off. Adds that the batters will have a field day and the team winning the toss will look to bat first.

Mahmudullah the skipper of Bangladesh says that they are comfortable with bowling first, the wicket looks good and they will look forward to restricting West Indies to a decent total. Adds that in the previous game they had a good start but failed to capitalize on that in the middle over but it's a new day and they want to put on a better show. Informs that they have made two changes.

Nicholas Pooran the captain of West Indies says they will have a bat first. Mentions that the wicket looks really good and the sun is out today as well. Adds that from a bowling point of view they would like to assess the conditions fast just like in the last game and he is happy with the bowling. Informs that unfortunately Devon Thomas has a niggle and he will be replaced by Keemo Paul.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Anamul Haque, Litton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Mosaddek Hossain (In for Munim Shahriar), Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed (In for Nasum Ahmed).

West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C/WK), Rovman Powell, Odean Smith, Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein, Keemo Paul (In for Devon Thomas), Obed McCoy, Hayden Walsh.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

The weather in Dominica seems clear! It is partly cloudy though but fewer chances of rain. The fans at Dominica might get to witness a full game! Let's not be overexcited and let's hope for the best. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
